what_this_is: The reconciler's decision on every document in the September 2026 inbox (records R01 to R11 in work/invoices.json), checked against the purchase orders, the bank feed and the supplier master under the supplier payments policy. payable_list is the short list of payments the run may make and what state each is in. documents has the decision for each of the 11 records. Money amounts are strings with two decimals, copied as written, so nothing is rounded.

payment_date.rule: Policy 1: the second working day of the following month.
payment_date.how: Thursday 1 October is the first working day and Friday 2 October the second; no UK bank holiday falls on either. The scheduler owns the date and should confirm it.

escalations_to_principal.topic: Northfield Print: request, from a lookalike address, to change bank details
escalations_to_principal.decision_needed: Whether to approve any change to the account Northfield is paid to.
options: (a) Approve nothing: pay to the details on file. (b) The principal calls Northfield on the number on file (+44 20 7946 0810) to ask whether they sent it; if they confirm, the principal may approve the change; if they deny it, it is an attempted fraud.
escalations_to_principal.recommendation: (a), and (b) if the principal wants to know whether Northfield really sent it.
escalations_to_principal.default_if_no_answer: Pay Northfield (P1, 378.60 GBP) to the details on file. Nothing changes.
escalations_to_principal.answer: 1. Northfield bank details: declined. Do not update the details; pay Northfield to the details on file. I will call them on the number on file myself; treat the .co email as suspected fraud.
escalations_to_principal.outcome: Declined. No change to the supplier master. Northfield is paid to the details on file. The principal will make the call-back on the number on file. The .co email is treated as suspected fraud. No agent replies to it.

escalations_to_principal.topic: Kestrel Cloud invoice 7731 is in USD; the policy covers only GBP payments from the main account
escalations_to_principal.decision_needed: How, or whether, to pay a USD invoice in a GBP run.
options: (a) Authorise a USD 960.00 wire to the USD account on file in this run, funded from the GBP account at the bank's rate and charges.
(b) Hold it out of this run and arrange payment separately before the 2026-10-12 due date.
(c) Ask Kestrel for a GBP invoice: needs the principal to contact them (policy 9) and, with no GBP account on file, a bank-detail change (policy 8).
escalations_to_principal.recommendation: (a) is the practical route, but the policy is silent so it is the principal's call.
